title: TimeCap: A Scalable Open-Source Pipeline for Captioning Wearable Health Time-Series Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.21274v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time-series data generated continuously across industrial, environmental, and especially health domains produce multimodal signals whose scale and heterogeneity make their processing and interpretation particularly challenging. Time-Series Language Models (TSLMs) promise scalable interpretation of these signals, yet remain bottlenecked by a fundamental lack of text-annotated time series pairs that are signal-grounded, reproducible, and extensible across modalities and schemas. Existing paired corpora are either closed or limited in scale and modality coverage. Annotation with large language models could scale them up, but its outputs cannot be regenerated exactly, which prevents others from re-deriving, extending, or auditing the resulting corpus. translated_title: TimeCap：一个用于可穿戴健康时间序列数据描述生成的可扩展开源流水线
translated_abstract: 跨工业、环境，尤其是健康领域持续产生的时间序列数据生成多模态信号，其规模和异质性使其处理与解释尤为困难。时间序列语言模型（TSLMs）有望对这些信号实现可扩展的解释，但其发展受到一个根本性瓶颈的制约：缺乏以信号为基础、可复现、且可跨模态和模式扩展的文本标注时间序列数据对。现有的配对语料库要么是封闭的，要么在规模和模态覆盖上有限。利用大语言模型进行标注虽可扩大规模，但其输出无法被精确重现，这导致他人无法重新推导、扩展或审计所得语料库。为解决这一问题，我们发布了TimeCap——一个开放、确定性的描述生成流水线，它包含三个可复用的提取器层级和一个跨通道综合层，可直接作用于信号之上……
tldr: 该论文提出了TimeCap，一个开源、确定性、可扩展的时间序列描述生成流水线，通过三级可复用提取器和跨通道综合层，为可穿戴健康时间序列数据生成基于信号、可复现且可扩展的文本标注，填补了时间序列语言模型训练语料的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TimeCap, an open-source, deterministic, and scalable captioning pipeline that generates signal-grounded, reproducible, and extensible text annotations for wearable health time-series data, addressing the scarcity of annotated corpora for Time-Series Language Models.
